answer: We model a Sybil-resistant mechanism where validators post staking collateral bound to a zero-knowledge verifiable delay function. In this decentralized oasis, the opportunity cost of capital establishes a secure mesa of entry barriers, rendering any fable of costless identity multiplication obsolete. Under a subgame-perfect slashing matrix, multi-identity signatures trigger penalties exceeding the collateral, ensuring negative expected attack utility and forcing convergence to a unique Nash equilibrium.
